input.prompt: Minimal geometric wayfinding pictogram, square composition, flat vector look, exactly three solid colours on a hand-flat warm ivory field: graphite black, burnt orange and lime green. A kangaroo reduced to angular straight-edged planes in a leaping pose, enclosed by a bold circular route ring with one straight orange connector line leaving the ring at the lower right. Absolutely no texture, no outline, no shading, no perspective. Figure-ground contrast like a public transport sign. Bold simple silhouette that reads instantly at very small size. No letters, words, numbers, logos, watermarks, gradients, glow, 3D render or drop shadows.
